description: This file is a part of the Smarty templating engine, specifically implementing a class that represents double-quoted content in the parse tree used during template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_DqContent
classes.description: Represents raw double-quoted string content in the Smarty template parse tree, allowing conversion back to PHP string format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new parse tree node with string data.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Converts the parse tree node content to a double-quoted PHP string.
